info.name: PHYSIO - INVIT Assistant E2E + STC chain

description.content:
End-to-end: login as cabinet kine admin, invite ASSISTANT to {{inviteAssistantTargetEmail}} (default oussemak9999@gmail.com), then exercise invitation STCs.

**Credentials:** Set collection or environment variables `kineAdminEmail` and `kineAdminPassword` (e.g. password containing `KineAdmin123` as you use in QA).

**Run order:** Use Collection Runner top-to-bottom. Negative accept/preview cases are placed before nominal accept so the assistant token stays valid until STC-INVIT-ACCEPT-001/B.

**STC-INVIT-GEN-008/B, STC-INVIT-ACCEPT-003/004/008/B:** Not present in the checked Excel export; requests follow the same API patterns as the main KINE collection (GEN-008 = invalid generate payload 400; ACCEPT-003 = replay after consume 409; ACCEPT-004 = INVITATION_ACCOUNT_MISMATCH when applicable; ACCEPT-008 = CGU rejected 400). Adjust expectations in Tests if your sheet differs.
